description: Send orders to ShipStation and get tracking back automatically
name: ShipStation

highlights.title: Orders appear in ShipStation
highlights.description: Paid orders are sent automatically with items, options, weights and addresses, ready to pick, pack and buy labels.

highlights.title: Tracking flows back to Swell
highlights.description: Every label bought in ShipStation becomes a Swell shipment with the carrier, tracking number and exact items shipped.

highlights.title: Partial shipments, handled
highlights.description: Ship an order in parts. Each label is its own shipment, and the order completes when the last item ships.

highlights.title: Edits and cancellations follow
highlights.description: Change an address or cancel an order in Swell and ShipStation is updated. Voided labels cancel the Swell shipment.

highlights.title: Sync status on every order
highlights.description: A ShipStation tab on each order shows its status and any error, with an errors view to find and re-send failures.

images.title: ShipStation for Swell
images.description: Orders go to ShipStation when they're paid. Labels you buy there come back to Swell as shipments with tracking.

images.title: From paid order to tracking
images.description: Paid orders reach ShipStation on their own, and each label bought there becomes a Swell shipment, partial ones included.

images.title: Choose when orders are sent
images.description: Send orders when paid, when submitted or only on request, add an order number prefix, and pick what else to sync.

images.title: More than the built-in integration
images.description: Everything Swell's built-in ShipStation integration does, plus edits, cancellations, voided labels and sync status.
